classification_correction: Reviewed final assessment verdict: independently demonstrated acceptance failures yield NO-GO; conservative nearest-referenced-vertex upper-bound failure alone yields BLOCKED because it does not establish actual surface damage; no failures yield PASS. Gates, populations, method and render admission remain unchanged. Frozen plan explicitly states this distinction.
source_and_math_checks: Original source/scene/native-byte/prior qualification/runtime identities remain pinned through the historical authentication closure; current outputs are exclusive and private.

One direct installed meshoptimizer0.22 stable simplify call uses original full vertex/index rows, target 2086792 triangles, error 0.005 and exactly LockBorder; no weld, prune, reorder, alternate method or retry.

Compact candidate positions and native RGBA bytes retain exact sorted original vertex IDs; oriented triangle correspondence, invalid/zero-area rejection, cyclic winding keys and original/component lineage are checked.

All 207 source face-bearing component identities must survive without bridging; candidate topology must retain 207 actual components, add no non-manifold edges and grow boundary length by at most five percent.

Exact nearest referenced-vertex distances are conservative upper bounds to sampled nearest-surface distances. Original unused vertices cannot rescue either direction; passing remains limited to the declared populations.

Four frozen orthographic 640-square views use pixel centres, two-sided first-hit depth, 0.98 IoU and 0.99 depth-aware visible-foliage retention; original known foliage ROI is bounded, not an all-leaf guarantee.

Each of 16 original source-ID regions receives 128 deterministic area-weighted candidate interior samples, without output-colour-dependent selection. Genuine eight-neighbour source field, RGB 0.02/0.05/0.15 and separate scalar RMSE 0.02 gates are applied per region; zero field support fails.

render_and_colour_review.material_reader: Pinned existing material_readback is count-generic. The saved original scene lends only its verified unchanged material; its full mesh is removed before candidate allocation.
render_and_colour_review.geometry: Bulk candidate construction preserves exact position bits, compact oriented loops, triangle counts and flat shading, with complete before/after readbacks and no repair or smoothing.
render_and_colour_review.colour: Exact retained original native bytes are set through color_srgb and every resulting CORNER BYTE_COLOR byte is read back before and after rendering. CPU numeric colour predictions use explicit IEC-decoded F32 native bytes and linear barycentric interpolation, without claiming native .color getter bit equality.
render_and_colour_review.studio: One +X Cycles CPU frame uses the authenticated actual camera, lights, world, flat material, 640 square, 32 samples, CPU OIDN, four threads and +2 EV; inspection reopens the original-size PNG and composes it with the existing accepted reference without rerendering the original.
render_and_colour_review.prior_qualification: Accepted original native-colour qualification and preview receipts are pinned. Their existence does not certify new reduced connectivity or interpolation; all current numeric gates and independent visual inspection remain required.

resource_and_lifecycle_review.lifecycle: Exact selected stage only; live admission before exclusive attempt marker, attachment before exact GO, fixed CPU environment, periodic live floors, preserved watched-source identities, measured process/Job peaks and natural empty-Job exit without forced cleanup required for host PASS.

A quality NO-GO/BLOCKED assessment is retained as diagnostic evidence and cannot admit render; no automatic retry or alternative follows.

launch_condition: GO only for the reviewed single bounded staged attempt after actual live admission. Candidate acceptance still requires actual numeric/resource PASS and independent visual inspection; fifty percent is a target and the predeclared meaningful reduction floor is twenty percent.
